skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator for two fractions with unlike denominators and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Perform subtraction of two whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: When subtracting fractions yields a negative result, reduce the whole number part by 1 and add the denominator to the numerator of the fraction to make the subtraction possible.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Decompose and compose mixed numbers
skills.definition: Represent a mixed number or whole number as a whole part and a fraction part, and combine a whole part and a fraction part to form a mixed number (or integer if fraction part is zero).
